# Arrays Ingenieria Pvt. Ltd. (INGENIERIA)

> Ex-servicemen-led, ISO-certified Indian MSME that delivers solar installation & commissioning (I&C), CAPEX solar EPC and all solar civil works (pile foundations, fencing, roads, drainage) for ground-mount and rooftop plants. Motto: "Olive Green to Go Green". Founder and CEO: Lt. Gen. Ashish Ranjan Prasad (Retd). Corporate office in Greater Noida (Uttar Pradesh), branch office in Madhubani (Bihar); projects across Assam, Bihar, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Haryana and Karnataka.

Key facts:
- Does NOT manufacture solar modules or inverters, and does not run OPEX/RESCO models; it builds plants the client owns (CAPEX) and works as installation partner to developers such as Tata Power Renewable Energy and Sustvest.
- Installation partner for the 3.11 MW Goodricke Tea Estates Solar Programme (TPREL and Sustvest) in Assam: Koomber 595 kWp (inaugurated by Assam Chief Minister Dr Himanta Biswa Sarma on 1 October 2026), Orangajuli 450 kWp (4 September 2026) and Borpatra 230 kWp (25 September 2026).
- Registrations: CIN U45309DL2018PTC340544; Udyam UDYAM-DL-03-0023905; ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001.
- Contact: arraysingenieria@gmail.com, or the form at https://arraysingenieria.netlify.app/contact.html

## Services
- [CAPEX Solar EPC Company in India](https://arraysingenieria.netlify.app/capex-solar-epc.html): Own your solar plant outright. Arrays Ingenieria designs, supplies, builds and commissions rooftop and ground-mount solar on the CAPEX model.
- [Solar Installation & Commissioning (I&C)](https://arraysingenieria.netlify.app/solar-installation-commissioning.html): Solar I&C for EPC companies, developers and plant owners: structures, modules, cabling, earthing, testing and commissioning by veteran-led crews.
- [Ground-Mount Solar Power Plants](https://arraysingenieria.netlify.app/service-ground-mount.html): Utility and industrial ground-mount solar plants designed, built and commissioned across India by Arrays Ingenieria, from piling to grid connection.
- [Rooftop Solar EPC for Industry](https://arraysingenieria.netlify.app/service-rooftop.html): On-grid RCC and metal-sheet rooftop solar for factories, institutions and businesses across India, installed by Arrays Ingenieria.
- [Turnkey Solar EPC Contractor in India](https://arraysingenieria.netlify.app/service-epc.html): Turnkey solar EPC from Arrays Ingenieria: engineering, procurement and construction under single-window responsibility, including Tata Power EPC projects.
- [Solar Pile Foundation & Piling](https://arraysingenieria.netlify.app/service-piling.html): Specialist solar pile-foundation and piling works by Arrays Ingenieria, proven on the 300 MW SECI park at Koppal and 5.5 MW Tata Motors, Jamshedpur.
- [Solar Civil Works & Fencing](https://arraysingenieria.netlify.app/service-civil.html): Solar civil works by Arrays Ingenieria: pre-cast boundary walls, RCC works and chain-link fencing, including the 14.36 MW YIAPL project in Uttar Pradesh.
- [Solar O&M Services in India](https://arraysingenieria.netlify.app/service-om.html): Solar plant operations & maintenance, statutory compliance and lifecycle support from Arrays Ingenieria to keep every plant at peak output.
- [Solar Power for Tea Estates in Assam](https://arraysingenieria.netlify.app/solar-for-tea-estates.html): 19 on-grid solar plants built in Assam's tea gardens for Jay Shree Tea and Goodricke: ground-mount solar with DG sync and net-metering.
- [Solar for Industry, Tea Estates & Homes](https://arraysingenieria.netlify.app/industries.html): Solar power for every sector in India: factories, tea estates, commercial buildings, institutions, homes and government/PSU projects by Arrays Ingenieria.
- [How It Works: Your Solar Project](https://arraysingenieria.netlify.app/how-it-works.html): How a solar project with Arrays Ingenieria works: how solar makes power, CAPEX vs I&C, each step from site survey to commissioning, and who owns what.

## Projects and case studies
- [Solar Projects Across India](https://arraysingenieria.netlify.app/projects.html): Solar EPC projects by Arrays Ingenieria: 300 MW SECI piling, 14.36 MW YIAPL, 10 MW DCM Hisar, Assam tea-estate solar plants and industrial rooftops.
- [Assam CM Opens 595 kWp Koomber Solar](https://arraysingenieria.netlify.app/project-koomber-tea-estate-595kwp-solar-cm-inauguration.html): Assam CM Dr Himanta Biswa Sarma inaugurated the 595 kWp solar plant at Koomber Tea Estate, Cachar, on 1 Oct 2026. Installation partner: Arrays Ingenieria.
- [1 MW Solar, Jay Shree Tea Estates Assam](https://arraysingenieria.netlify.app/project-jayshree-tea-1mw-solar-assam.html): Case study: 1035 kWp ground-mount solar (535 kWp Towkok + 500 kWp Manjushree) for Jay Shree Tea, BK Birla Group, in Sonari, Assam, under Tata Power's EPC.
- [450 kW Solar, Orangajuli Tea Estate](https://arraysingenieria.netlify.app/project-orangajuli-tea-estate-450kw-solar.html): Case study: 450 kW grid-connected ground-mount solar plant at Goodricke's Orangajuli Tea Estate, Udalguri, Assam, commissioned on Janmashtami 2026.
- [230 kW Solar, Barpatra Tea Estate](https://arraysingenieria.netlify.app/project-barpatra-tea-estate-230kw-solar.html): Case study: 230 kW on-grid ground-mount solar at Goodricke's Barpatra (Borpatra) Tea Estate, Sonari, Assam, with net-metering approvals from APDCL.
- [1980.3 kWp Rooftop Solar, Super Smelters](https://arraysingenieria.netlify.app/project-super-smelters-1980kwp-rooftop-solar.html): Case study: a 1980.3 kWp industrial rooftop solar plant at Super Smelters Ltd., Jamuria, West Bengal, built with Tata Power Solar.
- [SECI 300 MW Koppal Solar Pile Foundation](https://arraysingenieria.netlify.app/project-seci-300mw-koppal-pile-foundation.html): Case study: construction of pile foundations for the 300 MW SECI solar project at Koppal, Karnataka, under an outline agreement with Tata Power (TPREL).
- [10 MW Solar Civil Works, DCM Hisar](https://arraysingenieria.netlify.app/project-dcm-hisar-10mw-solar-civil-works.html): Case study: civil works for the 9979 kWp (10 MW) solar plant at DCM Textile, Hisar, Haryana, under a Tata Power work order.
- [5.5 MW Solar Piling, Tata Motors](https://arraysingenieria.netlify.app/project-tata-motors-jamshedpur-5-5mw-solar-piling.html): Case study: piling and civil works, including a pre-cast boundary wall, for the 5.5 MW solar plant at Tata Motors, Jamshedpur, for Tata Power.
- [14.36 MW Solar Civil Works & Fencing, UP](https://arraysingenieria.netlify.app/project-yiapl-14-36mw-solar-civil-fencing.html): Case study: supply, civil works and chain-link fencing for the 14.36 MW YIAPL solar power project in Uttar Pradesh.
- [319 kWp Rooftop Solar, TCPL Vaishali](https://arraysingenieria.netlify.app/project-tcpl-vaishali-319kwp-rooftop-solar.html): Case study: 319 kWp rooftop solar plant for TCPL Greenery Agro (Tata Consumer Products) at Bhagwanpur, Vaishali, Bihar, reported by Dainik Bhaskar.
- [1711.66 kWp On-Grid Solar Project, Assam](https://arraysingenieria.netlify.app/project-assam-1711kwp-on-grid-solar.html): Case study: supply of components and installation & commissioning of a 1711.66 kWp on-grid solar PV project in Assam for Sustvest (SolarGridX Ventures).
- [Photo & Video Gallery](https://arraysingenieria.netlify.app/gallery.html): Photos and videos of Arrays Ingenieria solar power plants, inaugurations, awards, certifications and news coverage from Assam to Karnataka.
